    Description

    Generic base Data Access Object class implementing CRUD operations via Java Reflection.

    Data Access Object specialized for managing Bill records manually.

    Represents a Client entity model.

    Business Logic Layer for Client operations.

    Data Access Object for Client entities.

    OrdersBLL

    OrdersDAO
    Data Access Object for Orders entities.

    User interface window for placing orders and viewing checkout logs.

    Represents a Product entity model.
    ProductBLL
    Business Logic Layer for Product operations.
    ProductDAO
    Data Access Object for Product entities.

    User interface window for managing Product stock operations.

    Dynamic JTable UI builder utilizing Java Reflection metadata.
